qa_pairs.question: Under the Customs Act, 1969, how is the 'Minimum Value' or 'Tariff Value' utilized when assessing Customs Duty for imported goods?
qa_pairs.answer: For the purpose of imposing Customs Duty on imported goods, the established minimum value or tariff value is considered the assessable value of the goods, as authorized under section 25(3) of the Customs Act, 1969.

qa_pairs.question: How does the government manage the transition of 'Minimum Value' notifications for imported goods subject to Customs Duty?
qa_pairs.answer: The government manages the valuation of imported goods by issuing new notifications under section 25(3) of the Customs Act, 1969, which explicitly repeal previous notifications (such as SROs 190-AIN/2010, 159-AIN/2011, 159-AIN/2012, and 146-AIN/2013) to set updated tariff values for Customs Duty purposes.
